summary: Lead Software Engineer with 11+ years of experience designing, building and operating production software in startup environments. Strong background in backend architecture, distributed systems, event-driven systems, PostgreSQL, APIs and the JVM ecosystem, with hands-on experience across Kafka, TypeScript/Node.js, CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes. Experienced in taking projects from initial design to production and long-term technical ownership. Pragmatic, autonomous and comfortable learning new technologies and domains.
